effect_description_eng:
While you have a Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Trash] [End of Your Turn] If you have a Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name, by returning this card to the bottom of the deck, trash your top security card and 1 of your Digimon attacks without suspending.
[Main] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.), ＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.), ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and +3000 DP.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] You may play 1 [Lucemon] from your trash without paying the cost.
